data.title: El Nino sets temperature record in key Pacific zone: EU monitor
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - An intensifying El Nino broke a temperature record in a key zone of the Pacific in September, the EU's climate monitor said Monday, in another sign the weather pattern is gaining exceptional strength.

data.title: Riyadh airport hit by fresh Houthi strike day after deadly attack
data.description: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia - A fresh Houthi strike hit Riyadh's international airport on Sunday, killing one person and wounding 11 others, a day after a deadly attack claimed by the Yemeni group forced authorities to suspend operations there.

data.title: Top NATO commander set to issue warning to Russia over any attack
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - NATO's top military commander is expected to deliver a warning to Russia on Monday over the alliance's ability to counter any attack, as worries grow over the threat from Moscow.

data.title: World leaders urged to 'course correct' as UN nature goals fall short
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Nations are steeling for a disappointing report card at this month's UN biodiversity summit, with governments falling short on their commitments to protect the plants, animals and ecosystems that sustain life on Earth.

data.title: Korea Season continues with  'K-Live Festival '
data.description: Top Korean and Thai live bands will be sharing the stage during "K-Live Festival In Bangkok", which will take place at UOB Live, 6th floor of Emsphere, Sukhumvit Road, on Saturday at 5pm.

data.title: 'Emdining J Festival 2026' ends Sunday
data.description: More than 30 leading restaurants within Emporium, EmQuartier and Emsphere present a variety of 100 specially curated vegetarian dishes during "Emdining J Festival 2026" until Sunday.

data.title: Your daily horoscope for Oct 12
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Heavy rain may return to Greater Bangkok on Tuesday
data.description: The Meteorological Department predicts heavy rain will be in the South on Monday and expand to the lower North, the lower Northeast, the Central Plains including Greater Bangkok and the East on Tuesday.

data.title: Stars stacked, Philly now the team to beat
data.description: Now that the Philadelphia 76ers have acquired superstar Jaylen Brown and won the LeBron James free agency lottery, they are just about everyone's pick to notch their first NBA title in 43 years.

data.title: Conservation groups alarmed at marine mammals' deaths in Spain
data.description: NICE (FRANCE) - Conservation groups on Sunday condemned the death of a dolphin transferred from France to a Spanish marine park, saying it added to the deaths of other sea mammals recently moved to Spain from Canada.

data.title: Lula stages mass rally ahead of Brazil's presidential run-off
data.description: SAO PAULO - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva led a massive rally Sunday to call for more days off for workers ahead of an election runoff against his right-wing opponent Flavio Bolsonaro.

data.title: Policymakers take on energy shock, rising debt at IMF-World Bank meetings
data.description: BANGKOK - Finance ministers and central bankers meet in Bangkok this week for the annual gatherings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, with the global economy buffeted between the US-Iran war's energy shock, rising debt pressures and the AI boom.

data.title: Raphael Glucksmann elected centre-left French presidential candidate
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Eurodeputy Raphael Glucksmann was on Sunday elected the centre-left candidate for next year's French presidential elections, organisers of the vote said, winning comfortably in the first round.

data.title: That Night I Loved Joshua Wong  staged in honour of HK activist
data.description: To mark one year since the arrest of Hong Kong human rights activist Joshua Wong, Qrious Theatre presents a rehearsed reading of the play That Night I Loved Joshua Wong, at SSS Samyan, Rama IV Road, daily at 7.30pm from Thursday to Sunday.

data.title: Protest ban near IMF venues
data.description: The Metropolitan Police Bureau (MPB) has banned public gatherings around the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), venues hosting official functions and hotels accommodating delegates to the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026 until Oct 20.

data.title: Retirement scheme near finish
data.description: An early retirement scheme for civil servants is nearing completion, with plans to reduce the civil service workforce by 5% annually, starting in fiscal 2027, says Deputy Prime Minister for Legal Affairs Pakorn Nilprapunt.

data.title: JIC denies delaying new talks
data.description: Thailand has denied Cambodia's claim that it is delaying a Joint Boundary Commission (JBC) meeting and hindering border surveys and demarcation.

data.title: Poverty falls, but 3.6m remain at risk
data.description: Thailand's poverty rate fell to 3.27% in 2025, leaving 2.3 million people below the poverty line. But another 3.6 million remain at risk of joining them if their incomes take a hit, the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) said.

data.title: DDC: No plague outbreak in Russia
data.description: The Department of Disease Control (DDC) said on Sunday there was no evidence of an outbreak in Russia following reports of a suspected death from pneumonic plague there.

data.title: Govt orders checks of care facilities
data.description: The government has ordered inspections of all 1,203 registered elderly and dependent care facilities nationwide within two months following reports of overcrowding, unlicensed operations and alleged abuse in Kanchanaburi and Nonthaburi.

data.title: Thai films take the stage in Busan
data.description: The nerve centre of Asian cinema this week is in Busan, the South Korean port city and host of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF). A premier film event on this side of the globe, the BIFF's role as a podium for outstanding Asian titles has long been cemented and this year Busan presents three new Thai films: Banjong Pisanthanakun's Inherit, a grand guignol adaptation of a classic horror novel; Phuttiphong Aroonpheng's The Burning Giants, in which a Karen man is trapped in a hazy fog of uncertainty; and Bua, an adolescent drama about a teenage girl in rural Thailand in the midst of the 1973 political unrest, directed by Inthira Charoenpura and Phensiri Klangsurin.

data.title: Dems pose water project questions
data.description: The Democrat Party is pressing the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) to clarify land transactions linked to the cancelled Bueng Khu Bon water-retention project and revive the scheme to prevent flooding in eastern Bangkok.

data.title: Thailand stays in Tier 2  of US trafficking report
data.description: Thailand has been placed in Tier 2 of the US Trafficking in Persons (TIP) Report for the fifth consecutive year.

data.title: SSB election proceeds without major incidents
data.description: Insured workers voted on Sunday to elect representatives to the Social Security Board (SSB), with no major incidents reported.

data.title: Govt denies neglecting flood victims
data.description: The government has denied neglecting flood victims while hosting the IMF-World Bank annual meetings, saying financial assistance had been available since Sept 26.

data.title: Censure debate timeline sparks row
data.description: Government Chief Whip Korrawee Prissananantakul said on Sunday that three days should suffice for the planned no-confidence debate as many of the opposition's allegations seem to overlap.

data.title: Commission urged to rebuild public trust
data.description: Academics have called on the Election Commission (EC) to address concerns over ballot secrecy and rebuild public trust ahead of the next Senate election, due in just over two years.

data.title: Seasoned DNP vet named 'SDG Star'
data.description: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Thailand has appointed a prominent veterinarian from the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP), Pattarapol Maneeon, as an "SDG Star".

data.title: Elderly care mistreatment in focus
data.description: The recent discovery of overcrowding, unlicensed operations and mistreatment at care facilities in Kanchanaburi and Nonthaburi has exposed potential weaknesses in the elderly care oversight system, prompting nationwide inspections and calls for tougher enforcement.

data.title: Leaders Buriram rally to sink Rayong at home
data.description: Buriram United came from behind to edge 10-man Rayong 3-2 in a pulsating Thai League 1 encounter at Chang Arena on Saturday night.

data.title: Ratchanok's title bid comes a cropper in Finland final
data.description: Ratchanok Intanon's hopes of winning her second World Tour title of the year and the 10th of her career ended in disappointment as the Thai ace fell to Mia Blichfeldt in the final of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Sunday.

data.title: Thai delegation off to Japan, aims for another 27-gold haul
data.description: The 265-member Thai national para team left for Japan on Sunday to participate in the 5th Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, from Oct 18-24.

data.title: Poland holds suspect in alleged assassination plot against PM Tusk
data.description: WARSAW - Polish police are investigating after arresting a man suspected of plotting an attack against Prime Minister Donald Tusk and defence minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, the interior ministry told AFP on Sunday.

data.title: Three Premier League talking points
data.description: LONDON - Manchester City gave a defiant response after being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules as the leaders romped to victory at Liverpool.
